initial_generation.pic4:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Tyrian 2000 title-screen background, original PIC4 only.
Edit target: the supplied complete original320x200 planet background. Reconstruct the same artwork at high resolution, keeping the original16:10 full canvas and exact composition. Prefer1600x1000.
Preserve the curved red/maroon planet sweeping from upper-left across the lower-left and lower-right, the same pale white/gray cloud bands and streaks, the soft muted mauve atmospheric rim, and the empty black space in the upper-right. Keep the original planet silhouette and horizon curve: do not change its size, location, tilt or curvature. Match the original broad cloud shapes and red land/shadow masses while replacing coarse pixel steps with coherent fine continuous painted/cloud detail.
Retain the restrained retro pre-rendered sci-fi aesthetic and original dark red/white/mauve/black palette. Do not turn it blue, add extra planets, stars, flares, ships or new landmarks. Do not add any logo, numbers, lettering, menu, cursor or version text. It must remain a clean independent background for separately animated gold logos and live menu text. Native640x400 clarity matters more than noisy microtexture. Opaque full screen.
initial_generation.sprite146:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: the separate transparent Tyrian title logo sprite, original PLANET_SHAPES sprite146.
Edit target: the supplied original304x121 RGBA logo. Reconstruct this exact bespoke “Tyrian” wordmark, with smooth high-resolution contours and carefully shaped gold-metal shading. It must remain the same logo, not a new font or alternate lettering.
Use the identical full304:121 canvas aspect ratio, preferably1536x612, with genuine transparent background. Preserve original registration and full canvas; do not add generous margins or crop/center/resize the word relative to the canvas. The original almost fills it, with only about1 logical pixel transparent border at top/left.
Follow every original letter silhouette, cutout/counter and ornament: the sweeping left T bar, strongly slanted connected letters, long hooked descender near the left-middle, very tall curved rising spike near the right-middle, and the long sweeping terminal flourish along the lower right. Keep these features at their original relative positions and sizes. Spell exactly “Tyrian”, but reproduce the reference's custom stylized shapes rather than typesetting.
Preserve the original warm muted bronze/gold surface, darker brown planes at left/bottom and concentrated pale-gold highlights across the central and upper-right letter planes. Refine broad metal planes and narrow bevels. Do not inflate the bevel or add jewel/plastic gloss, etched noise, extra flourishes, black outline, drop shadow or halo.
No planet, numbers, trademark or other text belongs to this sprite. All outside and interior cutout areas must be genuinely transparent, including the original letter counters. Smooth subpixel edges, clean native640x400 readability.

alpha_correction_history.titleTyrianNegativeCorrectionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target is image 1, the refined gold Tyrian wordmark with transparent background. Image 2 is the original 304x121 game wordmark and image 3 is the same original enlarged on a purple viewing matte. Image 4 compares two small problem regions (original at left, refined target at right).
Make ONLY a negative-space topology correction to image 1. Preserve its exact gold rendering, letter shapes, sweeping top bar, large hooked lower descender, tall upper spike, right terminal flourish, proportions and full wide canvas. No new design.

The refined target mistakenly closes three narrow gaps that are OPEN to the exterior in the original:
A. Beside the small inward curl near one third of the width (logical x93..102,y55..68 in the original 304x121 canvas), open the slim channel between the left adjoining stroke and the lower triangular gap. Keep the separate original small enclosed counter at x98..105,y49..58.
B. Around the small curl below the tall upper spike near two thirds of the width (logical x201..213,y53..71), restore the original continuous open channel around that curl. The upper triangular gap and the tiny lower curl gap must communicate with the surrounding transparent exterior, not form two enclosed counters. The curl should end freely rather than attach to the adjacent sloping stroke.
Use the original reference to identify which gold bridges to remove, but use smooth high-resolution contours and existing narrow bevel treatment, never pixel-stair edges. Remove only the small accidental joining bridges. Do not erase the entire curls or enlarge unrelated spaces.
Output the same complete isolated gold wordmark, genuinely transparent background. The purple is a reference matte ONLY, do not include it. Exact same bounds and placement as image 1; no zoom, no recentering, no crop; all other artwork unchanged.
